title: etale limit affine corrected lift
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a diagram of affine qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a limit cone. Let F_i be abelian sheaves on the small etale sites of D_i, with inverse-image transition maps phi satisfying the identity and composition laws. Let G_i be their pullbacks along c.pi_i, with specified isomorphisms eG commuting with transitions, and let L be a colimit cocone for G. For every n ≥ 0 there is a compatible coefficient system R with limit pullback diagram T, colimit K, and additive connecting maps delta_i : H^n(R_i) → H^(n+1)(F_i) commuting with stage transitions. For every x in H^(n+1)(F_i) with zero limit image, there is a later stage j, an arrow f : i → j, and z in H^n(R_j) with zero limit image such that delta_j(z) is the f-transition of x. Conventions: schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; cohomology and pullback maps [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]; diagrams, cones and colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Apply the exact-ladder theorem to obtain E, R, their limit diagrams and colimits, the degree-n comparison diagram for E, and the connecting maps and exact comparison squares. Lift x by surjectivity of the stage connecting map to z0. Its limit image lies in ker beta, hence equals alpha_0(w) for some w by limit exactness.
Apply etale_limit_cohomology_class_descent to the E system in degree n to represent w by a class v at stage k. This is existence in a smaller degree, not eventual-zero detection.

Take a common stage j above i and k, transport v and z0, and subtract alpha_j(v) from the R class. Cocone naturality and the alpha comparison square show that its limit image is zero. Connecting naturality and delta alpha=0 show that its connecting image is the transition of x. Directedness is supplied by IsFiltered.max and its two arrows.

proof_origin.place: Lean implementation: exact-ladder elimination, degree-n class descent, common-stage transport and subtraction.

theorem etale_limit_affine_corrected_lift
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (R : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ρ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (R i) ⟶ R j)
    (_hidentityR : ∀ i : I, ρ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (R i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (R i))
    (_hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ρ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (R i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ρ f) ≫ ρ g)
    (T : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eT : ∀ i : I, T.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (R i))
    (_hT : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), T.map f =
      (eT i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (R i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (ρ f) ≫ (eT j).inv)
    (K : Cocone T) (_hK : IsColimit K)
    (δ : ∀ k : I, Sheaf.H (R k) n →+ Sheaf.H (F k) (n + 1)),
      (∀ (j k : I) (g : j ⟶ k) (z : Sheaf.H (R j) n),
        δ k (Sheaf.H.map (ρ g) n (cohomologyMap (D.map g.op) (R j) n z)) =
          Sheaf.H.map (φ g) (n + 1)
            (cohomologyMap (D.map g.op) (F j) (n + 1) (δ j z))) ∧
      (∀ (i : I) (x : Sheaf.H (F i) (n + 1)),
        Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) (n + 1)
          (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) (n + 1) x) = 0 →
        ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (z : Sheaf.H (R j) n),
          Sheaf.H.map ((eT j).inv ≫ K.ι.app j) n
            (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op j)) (R j) n z) = 0 ∧
          δ j z = Sheaf.H.map (φ f) (n + 1)
            (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) (n + 1) x))
